videos.title: What Happens to Your Body After Stopping Ozempic
videos.point: 25-40% of Ozempic weight loss is muscle; after stopping, regained weight is mostly fat and muscle does not return, slowing metabolism.
content: GLP-1 acts on brain to cut hunger and slows digestion
Side effects persist: gastroparesis, vision/hair loss, deficiencies, pancreatitis
Counter with resistance training + leucine-rich animal protein
videos.watch_why: Concrete mechanism and percentage on muscle loss plus actionable protocol; not just side-effect list.
